# Chord Player (Chord Sequence)

> chordsequence.com — Create chord progressions with drag-and-drop editing, real-time playback, multiple rhythm styles, and MP3 export.

Chord Player is the web app on Chord Sequence (chordsequence.com) for songwriters and musicians to build, arrange, and export chord progressions across configurable sections, instruments, and tempos.

## Pages

- [Songs Library](/): Browse, search, duplicate and delete your saved chord progressions.
- [Editor](/editor): Create a new song — add sections, place chords, pick a rhythm style, transpose, and export to MP3.
